$comment: Master requirements registry (W-090/W-092). EVERY owner requirement is listed here. Built features list the test files that prove them and a proof level: unit = Node tests only (logic/assets, no real browser); e2e = also exercised in a real browser by tests/e2e (CI job 'Browser e2e smoke'); device = verified on target hardware/stores; prod = verified live with real users. Planned items have no proof yet. 'online: true' marks items that need the backend that does not exist yet (docs/ARCHITECTURE_PLATFORM.md). Add your feature in the same PR that builds it.
